resources.string: V2rayG is an independent fork of 2dust/v2rayNG 2.2.6, licensed under GNU GPL v3. Original authors retain their copyright. Gateway modifications: 2026-09-24. Source and license are available through Source code below.

V2rayG loads bundled Loyalsoldier GitHub data on first launch. AI and overseas domains use the selected proxy; domestic domains/IPs and unmatched traffic are direct by default. Enabled rules are evaluated in order. Changes reconnect VPN when you return home. Custom full-core configurations use their own routing.
Cannot initialize rule files. Open GitHub rule source and updates to replace them. VPN startup will report the error.
Cannot fully stop the previous connection. Force stop V2rayG in Android settings before reconnecting.
Import %1$d rules? This replaces unlocked rules; locked rules stay first. The unmatched-traffic setting is unchanged. An empty file array removes all unlocked rules.
Saved. Return to the home screen to apply.

Existing rules were not changed.

%1$s

Use a UTF-8 JSON array (up to 1 MiB) with domain: / full: / geosite: domains or IP/CIDR / geoip: rules and proxy / direct / block targets. Import binary .dat files in GitHub rule source and updates, not here.
